stacks.hook: Shopping for the people who are hardest to buy for? Three deals that make it easy, and the catch on each.

picks.text: One. The Fire TV Stick 4K Plus, twenty-nine dollars and ninety-nine cents, forty off. It gives an old TV a whole new life. The catch? You'll see ads on the home screen.
picks.feel: New life for an old TV

picks.text: Two. The HexClad ten-inch pan, a hundred and ten dollars, the best price ever, per CNN Underscored. Sunday breakfast that slides right off. The catch? It's still a lot for one pan.
picks.catch: Still pricey for just one pan.

picks.text: Three. The Aura digital frame, a hundred thirty-nine dollars, forty off. Send new family photos to it from anywhere. The catch? There's no battery, so it stays plugged in.
picks.catch: No battery; it stays plugged in.
